searchText: Hey, I've generated fancy Gloas Fork Choice [test vectors](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WxbkVMYanvhPlJD6mpcvQKR98HbsZMQa). They have both Exec Payload Envelopes and Payload Attestations. The test format is a likely extension of the existing test format. The files has prefix `_ep_pa.tar` to distinguish from less fancier test vectors. Thanks! Can look into this in a week or so.
